meaning.en: In reference to; with respect to; concerning.
meaning.vi: Trong tài liệu tham khảo để; đối với; liên quan.

meaning.en: Regarding is defined as in reference to.

Trình bày phân từ của sự quan tâm.

sentences.en: He opened it to confirm his presumption regarding Sarah's hair.

sentences.en: They codify laws regarding libel and slander.
sentences.vi: Họ hệ thống hóa các luật liên quan đến tội phỉ báng và vu khống.

sentences.en: That seems to be a very harsh way of regarding your sisters' future happiness.

sentences.en: But regarding him from within ourselves as what we are conscious of, we feel ourselves to be free.

sentences.en: I am hardly prepared to decide that question, or even give an opinion regarding it.

sentences.en: There were no two thoughts in agreement about anything regarding Xander.
